items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: So somehow, Prince Robinson lost his traveler's checkbook.

ctx.x: So everybody on the train is gambling-- Velma Middleton, Humph. M. HILLIARD; Shelton Simmons Sonny Woods, what's his name, yeah, and someone else. Always played poker. Velma and Sonny Woods always won. Louis Russell was in it, too.

So somehow, Prince Robinson lost his traveler's checkbook. He got up -- we had broken the train down completely level. Everything was a bed except the back of the train. The back of the seats, we had just uncovered them and let them down, you know. So Prince turned snow white overnight, his hair. Honest to God. His hair wasn't grey, it had, you know, tinges of grey, and the next day it was almost snow white. Worried him to death. Someone found it and was playing games on him. And they finally give it back to him.…

Boy, but that Louis Armstrong tour was something else, baby. We got to Atlanta, Georgia and they had chicken wire down through the middle of this auditorium. It was a dance. Whites on one side, blacks on the other. If the dance gets too good, the blacks got to leave, you know. If the music got too good, and some more whites wanted to get in there, the blacks
